name: openbb_commodity_price
description:
Energy spot prices (EIA series on FRED: crude oil, natural gas, fuels) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.commodity.price.spot).
Returns: {commodity, provider, data_points, truncated, prices: [{date, symbol, commodity, price, unit}]} or {commodity, error}.
Inputs (* required): commodity (wti, brent, natural_gas, jet_fuel, propane, heating_oil, diesel_*, gasoline_*, rbob or all; default wti); start_date (default 180 days ago); end_date; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fred; default fred).
Gold and silver: openbb_derivatives_futures_historical (GC=F, SI=F) or imf_get_data (PCPS, G001.PGOLD.USD.M); futures curve: openbb_derivatives_futures_curve. Keys: fred uses SAJHA's FRED_API_KEY.
Example: {"commodity": "brent", "start_date": "2026-07-01"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
